items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: The Oriole and Johnny Giles. Yeah.

ctx.x: What do you think was the best period of his musical career? When was the, when were the best years when he played music? What do you think?

Well, Louis had so many good, good, mixed in spots. Because I was crazy about, first thing everybody was crazy about the Hot Five. Never had another thing like that. Everybody tried to organize things, but they never got them close to the Hot Five. The Oriole and Johnny Giles. Yeah.
Little St. Cyr I think was in the place.
